description: Refers loading zone pilot update to Accessibility Committee.

chips.text: Accessibility Advisory Committee reviews pilot's impact on disabled residents.

description: City establishes process for accessible loading zone requests.
New policy sets eligibility and design standards.
Zones for schools, health facilities, civic, community uses.

chips.text: Received as information
Policy does not yet address snow removal for accessible loading zones.
Pilot participants and users expressed high satisfaction and support for zones.
Improves access to buildings for people using mobility devices.

description: City reviews 2% target for accessible loading zones.
May add more accessible spots if current provision is insufficient.

chips.text: Councillor questions 2% accessible parking target, suggests 4-5% needed.
Public speaker supports loading zones, notes frustration with misuse.
Dedicated loading zones improve accessibility for people with disabilities.
Staff promises to revisit 2% accessible parking target if insufficient.

description: Increases on-street accessible parking in pay zones.
Sets design standards and location criteria for spaces.
Prioritizes snow clearing for accessible parking and ramps.

chips.text: Approved
Committee found the proposed 2% cap on accessible parking insufficient for Broadway.
Out-of-town users and those with mobility or vision impairments.
Data on placard usage by Saskatoon residents is not yet available.
Public expressed strong support for accessible loading zones for mobility aids.
Accessible parking supply and snow clearing are critical for people with disabilities.
Staff committed to revisiting the 2% accessible parking cap if needed.

description: Future work plan will address Deafblind Services, transit, and accessibility.

chips.text: Approved
Work plan categories include Deafblind Services and Access Transit users.

description: Ad hoc subcommittees will form as needed.
